beat_phase.description: With tempo_factor 0.5: keep tracked beats 1,3,5... (0) or 2,4,6... (1). Default: the half that holds the tracked downbeats.
beat_phase.title: Beat Phase

beats_per_bar.description: Beats per bar (v0 songs are 4/4: keep 4).
beats_per_bar.title: Beats Per Bar

downbeat_shift_beats.description: ABSOLUTE: move the 'one' this many corrected beats from where the tracker put it (+1 = one beat later). Omit to keep it (it resets to 0 when tempo_factor changes).
downbeat_shift_beats.title: Downbeat Shift Beats

reset.description: Back to the raw tracker grid.
reset.title: Reset

tempo_factor.description: ABSOLUTE, relative to the raw tracker output: 0.5 = keep every 2nd tracked beat (the tracker counted eighths), 1 = as tracked, 2 = add a beat between each pair. Omit to keep the current factor.
tempo_factor.title: Tempo Factor

update_song.description: Rewrite song.yaml chops on this source so they cut the SAME audio on the new grid (false: leave them; the result says what they now cut).
update_song.title: Update Song
